# ATL2 · Which diary event–feeling relationships recur in independent halves of the same sources?

**Registered prediction.** No direction was registered. A cell qualifies when both half-sample intervals exclude zero on the same side in at least eight of ten splits.

**Source and sample.** Class P. The November 23 atlas of fourteen original diary and time-use sources, including public openESM releases, the couples diary and the US Bureau of Labor Statistics activity ratings. Member 0049 is counted separately. [Source inventory and previously filed atlas](https://github.com/EmotiveAutomaton/sounding-line/blob/a295e74ac0b3e13c3432e6695c9373c5dcd389bb/results/phase_2_4_stage_15/WEEK7/ATL_FOURTEEN_SOURCE_EXTENSION.md). The job finished 436 of 992 registered cells. Sizes in the summary count replayed cells. Each cell had ten planned splits. The checkpoints do not store participant totals for individual half-sample fits.

**Registered quantities.** Split people within each source into two groups ten times using the registered seeds. Within each half, fit the original event–feeling model and form intervals from 2,000 whole-person bootstrap draws. Take the median across estimable items within each source and then across sources. An undefined half earns no agreement. Replay every saved cell from the source with an independent decoder and a different calculation batch size.

all, replayed cells with at least eight agreements: 141 (416 cells).

**Verdict — descriptive, partial coverage.** In the all-source atlas, 141 of 416 replayed cells met the eight-of-ten rule (970 planned). Among the previously unexamined comparisons, 2 of 4 met it (6 planned). Member 0049 contributed a separate 1 of 16 (16 planned).

**Limit.** The CPU stop left a prefix of the frozen order. It cannot give a stability rate for the full atlas. Splits reuse the same participants and their reports.

**Withholding and release condition.** All 436 replayed cells are reported, including the qualifying event and feeling families. The remaining 556 cells were unmeasured. No interval was registered for a count of qualifying cells.
